name: Redis Triage Consumer
description: Drains the Redis 'triage:queue' list, claims each issue atomically with INCR on triage:seen:{owner}/{repo}#{number}, generates a TDD/BDD spec via the Claude shim, and posts it as a GitHub issue comment.

parameters.content:
## Redis queue consumer

RPOP drains triage:queue, which is FIFO against the LPUSH producers.

INCR on triage:seen:{owner}/{repo}#{number} is the atomic first-winner claim: it returns 1 only for the first caller, so the webhook and the poller can never both process one issue. TTL 7d keeps the keyspace bounded.

versionMetadata.description: Schedule-driven RPOP consumer for the Redis triage queue. INCR provides the atomic first-winner claim that dedups webhook against poller. Publishes the generated spec as a GitHub issue comment via the oneshot-pr-bot GitHub App.
